workflow_log.thought: Parse the user's degradation objective into a structured PROTAC workflow state.
Plan tool routing, retries, evidence search, user-input gates, stopping rules, and validation depth.
Set bounded linker, construction, stereoisomer, cheap-filter, and expensive-modeling budgets.
Check user request for haz ard patterns, unreasonable targets, or missing critical information.
Resolve target gene/protein name to UniProt entry and AlphaFold structure.
Retrieve known ligands for the target from ChEMBL, PubChem, BindingDB.
Select warhead molecules from curated library or provided smiles.
Select E3 ligase and ligand based on target biology and subcellular colocalization.
Detect suitable linker attachment points on warhead and E3 ligand molecules.
Generate curated and rule-based linker candidates matching requested classes and PROTAC-aware constraints.
Construct PROTAC candidates with multi-strategy deterministic assembly and provenance tracking.
Enumerate only a capped number of undefined stereoisomers and keep stereoisomers separately scored.
Sanitize, canonicalize, property-check, and deduplicate assembled PROTAC candidates.
Score E3/target compatibility using explicit cell-line and expression context.
Compute PROTAC-aware descriptor and toxicity-risk triage without strict Lipinski rejection.
Compare candidates against local known PROTAC-like records using fingerprints or deterministic string fallback.
Assess whether candidates are inside the demo model domain before ranking.
Apply validity, property, ADMET, novelty, domain, synthesis, and E3-context filters before expensive modeling.
Predict DC50, Dmax, degradation probability, confidence, and model-version provenance.
Rank candidates with weighted multi-objective scoring and pairwise-comparator-compatible outputs.
Cluster chemically similar candidates and identify diverse representatives.
Critique top candidates for evidence strength, overclaims, ADME/Tox risk, novelty, and synthesis plausibility.
Use review and ADME/Tox weaknesses to propose deterministic linker replacements and re-score evolved candidates.
Select a small ranked and diverse finalist set for ternary modeling.
Evaluate ternary complex formation via docking → P4ward pipeline.
Estimate ternary cooperativity from interface, linker strain, lysine geometry, and ternary feasibility evidence.
Model concentration-dependent ternary occupancy to detect high-dose hook-effect risk.
Rank candidates with weighted multi-objective scoring and pairwise-comparator-compatible outputs.
Convert assay feedback into supervised rows and report retraining readiness.
Generate transparent candidate table, workflow summary, provenance, warnings, and scientific limitations.
